CookieConsent.BannerText: We use cookies to run XTM Hub. Necessary cookies are always on, optional cookies (functionality, analytics, marketing) are used with your consent. Accept all, reject all, or manage your choices anytime in "Cookie settings".
CookieConsent.PreferencesIntro: By allowing these third party services, you accept their cookies and the use of tracking technologies necessary for their proper functioning.

necessary.Title: Strictly necessary
necessary.Description: These cookies are needed for the XTM Hub to function properly. They support core features, such as authentication, security and remembering your cookie preferences.

functional.Title: Functional
functional.Description: These cookies remember your preferences such as language or interface preferences and enable embedded features.

analytics.Title: Performance and analytics
analytics.Description: These cookies help us measure how the XTM Hub performs and how it's used, and identify errors so we can improve it.

marketing.Title: Marketing
marketing.Description: These cookies help us measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and, where applicable, personalize content or advertising based on your interactions with the XTM Hub.

WhatCanYouDo.Title: What can you do with your OpenAEV trial?
WhatCanYouDo.FirstParagraph: Get 30 days to explore all OpenAEV functionalities to simulate attacks, evaluate your defenses, and  improve your security posture. This includes all OpenAEV SaaS-based Enterprise Edition features, including the use of your existing EDR agents, automated scenario generation, and AI-powered remediation guidance.
WhatCanYouDo.SecondParagraph: Whether you want to want to simulate attack sequences, perform realistic tabletop exercises, validate your security posture, or report on your cyber resilience to leadership, you can test all OpenAEV capabilities for your specific needs.
WhatCanYouDo.Link: Discover all OpenAEV Enterprise Edition features

First.Title: Prioritize
First.Description: Build offensive attack simulations to identify vulnerabilities and exploitable attack paths, leveraging OpenCTI threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK mapping to prioritize threats based on your PIRs.

Second.Title: Test
Second.Description: Validate your defenses continuously through atomic testing, custom attack sequences, or pre-packaged scenarios. Run tabletop exercises to test team responses, using OpenAEV's native EDR or pre-built integrations with leading vendors.

Third.Title: Fix
Third.Description: Pinpoint where to improve your security posture with drill-down analytics, AI-powered remediation guidance, and team feedback — then close the loop with AI-assisted scenario creation.

WhatCanYouDo.Title: What can you do with your OpenCTI trial?
WhatCanYouDo.FirstParagraph: Get 30 days to explore all OpenCTI functionalities and enrich your threat intelligence. This includes all OpenCTI Enterprise Edition features such as automated playbooks, ability to set-up priority intelligence requirements (PIRs), FINTEL, as well as AI-powered files import, report generation, and NLP search functionality.
WhatCanYouDo.SecondParagraph: Explore how OpenCTI can support your specific needs—whether threat hunting, incident response, or case management—and integrate with your preferred data sources to make actionable threat intelligence flow across your security stack.
WhatCanYouDo.Link: Discover all OpenCTI Enterprise Edition features

First.Title: Ingestion
First.Description: Consolidate and enrich threat intelligence from any feed—commercial, open-source, internal—into a centralized platform, leveraging 300+ integrations and standardized on the STIX 2.1 framework. Use AI-assisted import of CTI reports to save countless analyst hours.

Second.Title: Processing
Second.Description: Access powerful dashboard visualizations, knowledge hypergraphs, and playbooks to pivot across threat actors using timelines and ATT&CK mappings. Tailor your dashboards to meet your threat or incident management needs, and make AI your companion at every step.

Third.Title: Output
Third.Description: Make threat intelligence flow through your entire security system. Share and disseminate intelligence across teams and tools with role-based access for timely action. Use OpenAEV—fully integrated with OpenCTI—to validate and improve your security posture.

opencti.Tagline: Unify and prioritize your threat signals
opencti.Description: Break data silos and operationalize threat intelligence with OpenCTI, an agentic platform built by practitioners, for practitioners, featuring automated playbooks, PIRs, FINTEL, and AI-powered import, reporting, and search. Enterprise-grade governance and sovereignty included.

xtmone.Description: XTM One is the agentic AI layer orchestrating assistive and agentic AI across OpenCTI and OpenAEV, moving you from threat signal to validated action at machine speed, human-in-the-loop, closing the loop on CTEM.

ActivateFeeds.Title: Enable 1-2 More Feeds
ActivateFeeds.Description: Go to Integrations in the left menu. A number of connectors have already been deployed. Click on the Available tab. You'll see that there are many more connectors that can be deployed with one click. In the left menu, scroll to the bottom and select Free in License type. Deploy some that have not yet been enabled. Click Browse More to see all integrations in the OpenCTI Library (including those without the one-click deployment option).

ConfigurePir.Title: Configure Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIR)
ConfigurePir.Description: Go to PIR → Create PIR. Define a PIR name, rescan period, and the entity criteria/filters that matter to you (e.g., "Malware targeting the Energy sector" with confidence ≥ 60). OpenCTI will now continuously listen to platform activity and automatically flag any matching entities as "of interest," surfacing a live news feed, scored relevance, and related reports/graphs for each.

FollowGraph.Title: Open a Report and Explore the Interactive Graph
FollowGraph.Description: Go to Analyses → Reports. Click on a report and go to the Knowledge tab. In the toolbar on the right, make sure Graph View is selected. Zoom in. Now click on objects in the graph. The details of the object will be displayed in the right column. To see the relationships of a particular object, move it out to the side. Click Timeline view to see how data points evolved over time. For MITRE ATT&CK mapping click on Tactics Matrix View.

CreateCase.Title: Create a Case from a Detected Indicator
CreateCase.Description: Go to Cases → Incident Response → Create Incident Response, spin up a case using a built-in template, and attach the indicator/report you worked with earlier. From there, assign a priority and severity, tag an assignee, and add related tasks to track remediation steps. Notice how the case stays linked to the underlying entities, so any new correlated intel will automatically surface in context.

CreateFintelReport.Title: Create a FINTEL report
CreateFintelReport.Description: Go to Analyses → Reports → Create Report. Draft a Finished Intelligence (FINTEL) report summarizing your analysis of the threat actor, malware, or campaign you've been exploring, pulling in the entities, indicators, and relationships you've already ingested. Attach supporting observables and link related intrusion sets or TTPs directly from the graph.

BuildDashboardWidget.Title: Build a Custom Dashboard Widget
BuildDashboardWidget.Description: Under Dashboards → Custom Dashboards, click Create Dashboard and add a widget (e.g., "Indicators by type" or "Reports over time"). Or select a pre-built dashboard by clicking on Import from Hub.

ConnectSecurityStack.Title: Connect to Your Security Stack
ConnectSecurityStack.Description: Go to Integrations. Click Browse More. Select some of the tools you already run (SIEM, EDR, firewall, TIP, or SOAR) to connect them to OpenCTI. Once connected, monitor the connector dashboard to confirm data is flowing, then verify that newly pushed indicators appear in your downstream tool.

CreateNoCodePlaybook.Title: Create a No-Code Playbook
CreateNoCodePlaybook.Description: Go to Data → Processing. Click Create Playbook. Use the visual, drag-and-drop builder to chain triggers, filters, and actions, such as auto-enriching new indicators, promoting high-confidence reports to a case, or pushing matching observables straight to a connector. Or select a pre-built playbook by clicking on Import from Hub.

CheckSecurityCoverage.Title: Check your Security Coverage with OpenAEV
CheckSecurityCoverage.Description: Link your OpenAEV instance under Settings → Integrations, then in OpenAEV go to Scenarios → Create and build a scenario from the ATT&CK techniques of the threat actor you've been investigating in OpenCTI. Add each TTP as an injection, assigning target assets, and hit Launch to execute the simulation in a controlled way.

EnableAgent.Title: Enable an Agent in XTM One
EnableAgent.Description: Open XTM One → Agents and activate one of the pre-packaged agents (e.g., the CTEM Assistant) to orchestrate a workflow across OpenCTI and OpenAEV - such as automatically enriching a new threat, summarizing it, and generating a validation scenario, all in plain English with no manual handoffs.

Academy.Description: Free, practical courses to how to get started with OpenAEV

Community.Title: OpenAEV Community

InstallStarterPack.Title: Install the OpenAEV Starter Pack
InstallStarterPack.Description: Do you need some content to get started? OpenAEV ships with a starter pack that provides ready-to-use content so you can run your first Simulation immediately after installation, including Pre-built Scenarios, dashboards, injectors, collectors, and agentless endpoints. The starter pack is available from the XTM Hub. Import it from Settings > XTM Hub after registering your platform.

RunAtomicTest.Title: Run an Atomic Test
RunAtomicTest.Description: Go to the Arsenal, pick a single technique, and select an endpoint to run it against. Install the OpenAEV agent first, or run agentless if supported. Launch the test and check the endpoint or wait for the report to see what executed and what got caught.

LaunchTimeBasedScenario.Title: Launch a Time-Based Scenario, Leveraging the AI Scenario Assistant
LaunchTimeBasedScenario.Description: Create a scenario and add injects in the order you want them to fire based on a set schedule with a start time and, if required a recurring frequency. Leverage AI to automate Inject creation based on your selected targets and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

RunAttackChainingScenario.Title: Run an Attack Chaining Scenario
RunAttackChainingScenario.Description: Build a scenario linking several techniques into a realistic attack path (initial access, lateral movement, exfiltration). Run it operator led, manually triggering each step yourself, or agent led, where the platform executes the whole chain automatically once started. Try both to feel the difference in control versus speed.

DriveTabletopExercise.Title: Drive a Tabletop Exercise with a Phishing Exercise
DriveTabletopExercise.Description: Create a tabletop scenario with communication or decision based injects instead of technical ones (e.g. "notify legal"), assign participants and run it as a live, facilitated session, recording how the team responds. Use this opportunity to include Phishing injects, which you can generate with AI directly.

EvaluateSecurityPosture.Title: Evaluate Your Security Posture
EvaluateSecurityPosture.Description: Start at home screen Exposure Commander Center (aggregating your key metrics at a glance) and drill down into specific security domains and dashboards. Take the time to investigate inject results, expectations, and findings.

GenerateDetectionRemediationRules.Title: Automatically Generate Detection and Remediation Rules
GenerateDetectionRemediationRules.Description: Generate detection rules from an executed technical Inject using AI-powered remediation. These can be accessed directly in the remediation tab of an inject results.

ConnectOpenctiSecurityCoverage.Title: Connect to OpenCTI for Security Coverage Enrichment
ConnectOpenctiSecurityCoverage.Description: OpenAEV can be triggered via an XTM Suite product to execute a scenario based on a desired threat profile, and results from the scenario execution — such as Detection rate, Prevention rate — are returned to the triggering product for ingestion.

EnableAgentXtmOne.Title: Enable an Agent in XTM One
EnableAgentXtmOne.Description: Open XTM One → Agents and activate one of the pre-packaged agents (for example, OpenAEV Assistant) to start orchestrating a workflow across OpenCTI and OpenAEV - such as automatically enriching a new threat, summarizing it, and generating a validation scenario, all in plain English with no manual handoffs.

GenerateReportStakeholders.Title: Generate a report automatically to share with stakeholders
GenerateReportStakeholders.Description: Review scenarios and their simulation results in a single report, generate as PDF or HTML in a single click to rapidly share with relevant stakeholders and benchmark over time.

Documentation.Title: XTM One Documentation
Documentation.Description: Technical docs and user guides to help you understand how the platform works

Community.Title: XTM One Community
Community.Description: The best place to ask any and all questions to the Filigran community

ActivateCtemAssistant.Title: Activate the CTEM Assistant
ActivateCtemAssistant.Description: Go to XTM One → Agents and enable the CTEM Assistant, your primary entry point into the platform. It connects directly to both OpenCTI and OpenAEV, orchestrating agents across both to move threat intelligence processing straight into scenario building and execution in OpenAEV - all from a single conversation.

AskQuestionPlainEnglish.Title: Ask a Question in Plain English
AskQuestionPlainEnglish.Description: Open the XTM One chat interface and ask something like "What are the top five threats facing financial sector in the UK?" XTM One will pull relevant entities from OpenCTI (once you have added some feeds) and return a synthesized answer with links back to the underlying data - no query language or dashboard-hopping required.

BuildThreatHuntingPackage.Title: Build a Threat Hunting Package in Minutes
BuildThreatHuntingPackage.Description: Search 'Threat Hunting' to access the OpenCTI Threat Hunt Creator. Ask it to turn a set of high-confidence indicators into a hunting package. It searches for high-value indicators, converts them into native detection rules for your platforms, and groups everything together in OpenCTI - cutting hunting prep time significantly.
BuildThreatHuntingPackage.ExamplePrompt: Example prompt: Create a hunt package for Lockbit ransomware IoCs, converted to Sigma rules, prioritizing the most recent indicators

IntegrateTools.Title: Integrate Tools for Faster Threat Detection and Response
IntegrateTools.Description: Go to Tools & Integrations to connect to tools your agents can use on your behalf. XTM One Integration Marketplace provide hundreds of pre-built integrations including for security tools like SIEMs, XDRs, threat feeds, vulnerability management and also business operations and collaboration tools like Notion, Metabase, Concord, MS Teams and Slack. Make intel flow seamlessly and be available at a central place to take an action.
